steps.text: Ursus, Icefield entrance, Wright-Kochinski Scientific Investigation Supply Depot

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Phew— Finally here.

steps.name: Device
steps.text: *beep* *beep* Please enter passphrase.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: *ahem*—Columbian Billy Bro, Ursus Cautus Dossoles, Horosho!

steps.name: Device
steps.text: Verifying passphrase...

steps.name: Device
steps.text: Confirmed. Xорошо, Columbian.

steps.name: Device
steps.text: Verifying speaker...

steps.name: Device
steps.text: Confirmed.

steps.name: Device
steps.text: Rhine Lab, serial number CRL005—

steps.name: Device
steps.text: (Strange tone) My-ma-meh-ma-ah~gah~lan~

steps.name: Device
steps.text: Welcome to the Wright-Kochinski Scientific Investigation Supply Depot.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Hmm—

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: (Fishes out notebook) 'Audio system in Ursus W-K station is slightly damaged—'

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: '—Maintenance unnecessary for now.'

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: That should do.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Professor Mary's team probably took enough supplies for, let's see, one, two, three... twenty people?!

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Twenty people's worth of supplies for a team of fifteen...

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: (Fishes out notebook) 'Only five percent of supplies remaining, enough for ten people (excluding myself)—requires restocking.'

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Now what else—

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Structure... shows no signs of damage. Energy... no recharge needed. Life support equipment... still good, temperature's alright.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: First aid kits appear to be unused, doors and windows show no sign of external damage...

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: And finally...

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: (Operates supply depot equipment)

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Yup, that's the route.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: (Confirms signals returning from outposts along the route)

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: The routine reports along the way suggest they didn't run into any trouble.
Two months ago
Columbia, Trimounts, Rhine Lab Headquarters, Scientific Investigation Section

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Alright, I'll prepare to depart then. Anything else you need me for?

steps.name: Scientific Investigation Section Member
steps.text: That should be all.

steps.name: Scientific Investigation Section Member
steps.text: (Quietly) There's one last thing, but you can't tell anyone.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Huh? Sure, I can keep a secret.

steps.name: Scientific Investigation Section Member
steps.text: (Glances around)

steps.name: Scientific Investigation Section Member
steps.text: (Quietly) Director Maryam's team went missing in the icefield.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Huh?! What happened to Professor Mary—

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Wmmmph!!

steps.name: Scientific Investigation Section Member
steps.text: (Quietly) Keep it down!

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Mmf, mrrmrmff.

steps.name: Scientific Investigation Section Member
steps.text: (Quietly) Anyway, that's the gist of it.

steps.name: Scientific Investigation Section Member
steps.text: (Quietly) So your top priority on this trip is to find and rescue the Director's team.

steps.name: Scientific Investigation Section Member
steps.text: (Quietly) The Exploration Society's already organizing their own search and rescue, but I'm sure you know how inefficient they always are.

steps.name: Scientific Investigation Section Member
steps.text: (Quietly) So... you're the only one they can count on.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: (Quietly) Got it.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: (Operates supply depot equipment)

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: The other outposts seem normal.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Which means they're still together.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: That, or...

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Hmm?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: A signal from a Columbian outpost?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: (Operates supply depot equipment)

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: (Picks up receiver)
This is @#￥-bian base—
We're under￥!@%&! Need... #￥!
Coordinates—

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: A signal sent by Professor Mary himself... Which means he should still be there!

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: But it would take some time for the signal to travel all the way here...

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: (Pats her own cheeks)

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: First things first, Magallan.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: (Presses console button)

steps.name: Device
steps.text: *Beep beep*

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: CRL005, Magallan.

steps.name: Device
steps.text: Identity verified. How may I help you?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Give me both the outgoing and incoming signal logs from Columbia in the last three or so months, thanks.

steps.name: Device
steps.text: Confirmed. Beginning encrypted callbacks to Messenger Outpost.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: (Switches console off)

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Ursus uses the base station established by the Exploration Society too, so that'll be convenient for applying for an icefield entry permit...

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: I can go as soon as the Messenger from Ursus gets here to confirm the documents.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: I'm on my way, Professor, so stay out of any serious trouble.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: That was fast— Please give me a moment, I'll be right there!

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Hi there.
Miss Venta Magallan.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Is this Mr. Ivan?

steps.name: Ivan
steps.text: Yes, on business as usual.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: One sec, I'll open the door for you.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Hello, Mr. Ivan. Would you like to take a rest inside?

steps.name: Ivan
steps.text: You know the rules, Miss Magallan. If I take even half a step forward, we'll never hear the end of it from the Columbians.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: It's just us here. Who's gonna know?

steps.name: Ivan
steps.text: Your little machine is already keeping a close eye on us.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Between you and me, the systems here aren't as smart as you'd think, haha.

steps.name: Ivan
steps.text: Still, better to be safe than sorry when dealing with the Columbians.

steps.name: Ivan
steps.text: Not that I don't trust you, of course. But allow me to decline your kind invitation out of an abundance of caution.

steps.name: Ivan
steps.text: Now then, if you could show me your documents?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Hyup.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: That should be all of them.

steps.name: Ivan
steps.text: Hm... entry permit... expedition permit... expedition route confirmation... cartography commission...

steps.name: Ivan
steps.text: Very good, Miss Magallan, everything seems to be in order.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Phew—

steps.name: Ivan
steps.text: That said, I have some unfortunate news for you—

steps.name: Ivan
steps.text: All icefield expedition permits this year have been cancelled.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Wha?!

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: That's, but... the documents should all be...

steps.name: Ivan
steps.text: I doubt this is the first time you've experienced this, so please try to understand our situation.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: But I have to go, it's urgent. Could... Could you please manage some kind of workaround?

steps.name: Ivan
steps.text: It's not impossible, if you can tell me why.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Really?!

steps.name: Ivan
steps.text: Really.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: So the thing is, we have a missing team out there and I need to find them, or at least confirm their situation.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: There are lives at stake here, so whatever conditions there are, I'll agree to them after I find them.

steps.name: Ivan
steps.text: Then you should have reported this through official channels and waited for an Ursus rescue team. Why set out on your own?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: I understand, I really do, but an official rescue team needs time to prepare, right?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: I'm an explorer too—one pretty familiar with the icefield if I do say so myself—and finding them even a day earlier will make the follow-up rescue that much simpler.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Also...

steps.name: Ivan
steps.text: I understand.

steps.name: Ivan
steps.text: Then do you mind sharing the missing group's last known coordinates?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Eh? Oh, okay, just give me a moment.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: They should be around here.

steps.name: Ivan
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Ivan
steps.text: (Ursine dialect) I've obtained the Columbians' coordinates. Based on them, they likely have something to do with what's happening in the north.
(Ursine dialect) Very good.

steps.name: Ivan
steps.text: (Ursine dialect) What do we do with the girl?
(Ursine dialect) She's supposedly a veteran explorer from Columbia, but her importance to the country is unclear. Keep an eye on her and await further instructions.

steps.name: Ivan
steps.text: (Ursine dialect) Understood.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Mr. Ivan...

steps.name: Ivan
steps.text: I just confirmed with my colleagues. My apologies, Miss Magallan, but we still can't let you head any further north.

steps.name: Ivan
steps.text: The front is under military control, so it's out of my hands.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Then...

steps.name: Ivan
steps.text: But to make up for it, I can accompany you anywhere within Ursus territory. My status as an Ursus official should simplify things for you.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Let me think then...

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Oh right, Sami!

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: No one would block me if I entered the icefield through Sami, right?

steps.name: Ivan
steps.text: In theory, yes. However—

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Then let's go to Sami first!

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: I'm all ready, Mr. Ivan. Please take me there now.

steps.name: Ivan
steps.text: (Ursine dialect) She wants to enter the icefield through Sami. Do you have enough time to run a background check?
(Ursine dialect) Just do what she wants. Investigating a Columbian with a public identity won't take long.
(Ursine dialect) When you reach the border, the guards will send someone to take over your job.

steps.name: Ivan
steps.text: (Ursine dialect) Roger.
(Ursine dialect) Be careful not to let the Witch spot you.

steps.name: Ivan
steps.text: (Ursine dialect) Understood.

steps.name: Ivan
steps.text: As you wish, Miss Magallan.

steps.name: 'Soldier'
steps.text: Captain, a moment please.

steps.name: 'Captain'
steps.text: You have a question, soldier?

steps.name: 'Soldier'
steps.text: Yes, Captain. Regarding... our mission.

steps.name: 'Captain'
steps.text: You have concerns about the military's arrangements?

steps.name: 'Soldier'
steps.text: No, sir. I wouldn't dare. I was only thinking, about how we treat the Sami—

steps.name: 'Captain'
steps.text: You pity those creatures?

steps.name: 'Soldier'
steps.text: Yes, Captain. I think—

steps.name: 'Soldier'
steps.text: Wait, what did you just say?

steps.name: 'Captain'
steps.text: I can understand your sympathy.

steps.name: 'Captain'
steps.text: Let me ask you a question though, soldier.

steps.name: 'Captain'
steps.text: As I recall, you're the son of a farmer.

steps.name: 'Soldier'
steps.text: Yes, Captain.

steps.name: 'Captain'
steps.text: Then, on your family's land, you must breed burdenbeasts. You use them to pull your carts, and otherwise create value as your father demands.

steps.name: 'Captain'
steps.text: Do you think those burdenbeasts would have done any of that on their own, without your father to tame them?

steps.name: 'Soldier'
steps.text: Of course not, Captain.

steps.name: 'Captain'
steps.text: So what makes you think the Sami would?

steps.name: 'Soldier'
steps.text: But, Captain—

steps.name: 'Captain'
steps.text: After the Ursus people overthrew the Hippogryph's rule, they spent a millennium transforming the land into what Ursus needed it to be.

steps.name: 'Captain'
steps.text: And yet Sami remains a desolate woodland.

steps.name: 'Captain'
steps.text: The Sami have contributed nothing to civilization.

steps.name: 'Captain'
steps.text: I believe that with proper guidance, they will eventually come to understand the painstaking efforts Ursus has made here.

steps.name: 'Captain'
steps.text: We've brought them the fire of civilization, so they should be shedding tears of gratitude.

steps.name: 'Captain'
steps.text: Yet their response, well, I believe it goes without saying.

steps.name: 'Soldier'
steps.text: Yes, Captain.

steps.name: 'Captain'
steps.text: They understand only strength, and more civilized means of persuasion fall on deaf ears.

steps.name: 'Captain'
steps.text: As such, violence is a necessary evil.

steps.name: 'Captain'
steps.text: But when their descendants are living in sturdy homes and enjoying the products of Ursus culture...

steps.name: 'Captain'
steps.text: —Then they'll understand.

steps.name: 'Soldier'
steps.text: Understood, Captain.

steps.name: 'Scout'
steps.text: Reporting in. A group of Sami sighted ahead, engaged in combat with the demons.

steps.name: 'Captain'
steps.text: Get in formation, and have the Caster team ready their Arts.

steps.name: 'Scout'
steps.text: Yes, sir!

steps.name: 'Soldier'
steps.text: Captain, you...

steps.name: 'Captain'
steps.text: Not even a disobedient burdenbeast deserves to be devoured by starving beasts, wouldn't you agree?

steps.name: 'Captain'
steps.text: All units, prepare to attack the demons.

steps.name: 'Soldier'
steps.text: —Yes, sir!
One week later, Sami-Ursus border

steps.name: Ivan
steps.text: Just a little further, and we'll reach the border sentry outpost. And Sami is a short trek from there.

steps.name: Ivan
steps.text: This is as far as I can accompany you.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: It's been a whole lot easier communicating with anyone from Ursus with you around.

steps.name: Ivan
steps.text: Your Ursine isn't bad, although your accent is thick.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: I doubt I'll be fixing that anytime soon, heh.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: And I still have a lot to learn. Sometimes I can't understand a word you're saying, Mr. Ivan.

steps.name: Ivan
steps.text: It's an obscure regional dialect. Not even other Ursus can understand me sometimes.

steps.name: Ivan
steps.text: I could teach you some on your next visit, if you're not so busy next time.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Really? That'd be wonderful, thanks!

steps.name: Ivan
steps.text: Ha, you're very welcome.

steps.name: Ivan
steps.text: By the way, are you particularly familiar with Sami?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Well, I've never used this route before, so not really.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: But I've heard it takes just as many supplies to get through Sami as it does to enter the icefield, and there are fewer outposts there as you get nearer to the icefield, so restocking is difficult too.

steps.name: Ivan
steps.text: Indeed, it is a savage place.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: You don't seem to like it much, Mr. Ivan.

steps.name: Ivan
steps.text: Normally, there is a permanent garrison at every outpost on the Ursus border, but the Sami-Ursus border only has regular patrols. Can you guess why?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Does... Ursus have some sort of dispute with Sami?

steps.name: Ivan
steps.text: Dispute? The Sami invaded Ursus territory and attacked our soldiers, all to satisfy their malicious, primitive desires.

steps.name: Ivan
steps.text: Even the sentry outpost up ahead was once occupied by the Sami for no reason at all. We even so kindly helped them repel the demons before issuing a protest to reclaim our territory.

steps.name: Ivan
steps.text: But they refused to leave, and even harmed our soldiers. In the end we had no choice but to drive them out with force.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Is that so...

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: (Is that so...?)

steps.name: Ivan
steps.text: The barbarous Sami exacted their revenge by sending out a vengeful spirit we call the Witch.

steps.name: Ivan
steps.text: She killed every last soldier at the outpost, and has been wandering the border ever since.

steps.name: Ivan
steps.text: Whenever she runs across a small squad, she'll engulf them in a snowstorm before going in for the kill, but if she meets a larger force she'll hide in the wind and snow.

steps.name: Ivan
steps.text: We can neither get rid of her nor chase her away. A real thorn in our side.

steps.name: Ivan
steps.text: In the end, our only option is to strengthen the border defenses with an elite patrol squad, simply to prevent the Sami from wreaking further havoc.

steps.name: Ivan
steps.text: You must also be careful when passing through Sami.

steps.name: Ivan
steps.text: The moment they spot an outsider, they will not stop until they rip out your throat to sip on your blood.

steps.name: Ivan
steps.text: Like the wild beasts swarming the snowfield, we can only keep them in check by force.

steps.name: Ivan
steps.text: Am I clear?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Y-Yeah, you're clear.

steps.name: Ivan
steps.text: Good.

steps.name: Ivan
steps.text: It's windy out here. Let's hurry to the outpost and get some rest.

steps.name: Sami Warrior
steps.text: Is the monster still there?!

steps.name: Sami Shaman
steps.text: It's been driven off, so we should be safe for now.

steps.name: Sami Warrior
steps.text: Phew... wonderful.

steps.name: Sami Warrior
steps.text: Hey, friends from Ursus! How is the situation over there?!

steps.name: Ursus Officer
steps.text: No casualties on our end.

steps.name: Sami Warrior
steps.text: Freya, do you still have any extra water? Bring some for our Ursus friends.

steps.name: Sami Shaman
steps.text: At once.

steps.name: Sami Warrior
steps.text: Phew. That was a little dangerous earlier. If you guys haven't helped out, some of our fledglings here might already be on their way to meet the ancestors.

steps.name: Ursus Officer
steps.text: Please, there's no need for that. We share a common enemy.

steps.name: Sami Warrior
steps.text: Where are you people headed to next?

steps.name: Ursus Officer
steps.text: We just happened to be passing by while performing our military duties.

steps.name: Sami Warrior
steps.text: The people of Ursus sure are stiff. We just fought demons, and you're still thinking about these 'military duties' of yours. Your brothers must be exhausted.

steps.name: Sami Warrior
steps.text: Come rest at our camp. Warm yourselves by the fire, and have some dried meat before hitting the road again, friend.

steps.name: Ursus Officer
steps.text: Then... I suppose it would be rude to refuse.

steps.name: Sami Warrior
steps.text: Hahahaha. There's no need to be so polite.

steps.name: Sami Warrior
steps.text: Freya, where's that water?!

steps.name: Sami Shaman
steps.text: I'm still patching someone up, give me a moment!

steps.name: Sami Warrior
steps.text: Forget about it then, we're bringing them back to camp for drinks!

steps.name: Sami Warrior
steps.text: Santalla!

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: What wrong?!

steps.name: Sami Warrior
steps.text: Double-check that there are no more demons in the area, while I take the wounded and our Ursus friends back to camp!

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Got it, then I'll return when I'm done. Remember to leave me a spot under the tree!

steps.name: Sami Warrior
steps.text: But of course.

steps.name: Sami Warrior
steps.text: Get up, kiddos! Time to head home!

steps.name: Ursus Officer
steps.text: Listen up, soldiers.

steps.name: Ursus Officer
steps.text: Advance in formation.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Is this really a sentry outpost? It's so spacious!

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: And this tree smack dab in the center. Does Ursus have a custom of planting trees in the middle of buildings, Mr. Ivan?

steps.name: Ivan
steps.text: It was planted by the Sami, and has been dead for a long time.

steps.name: Ivan
steps.text: But fortunately it's sturdy enough to act as a much needed barrier out here in the snowfield. So we decided to let it stand rather than cutting it down for firewood.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: There aren't any other trees in a hundred miles. So why would they randomly plant one right in the middle of the snowfield?

steps.name: Ivan
steps.text: I wouldn't know.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Can I... collect some samples?

steps.name: Ivan
steps.text: By all means.

steps.name: Ivan
steps.text: (Ursine dialect) We've arrived at the dead tree outpost; the Witch has not bothered us.
(Ursine dialect) We've finished our investigation into the girl, too. Her background is unremarkable, but we can make use of her expertise.
(Ursine dialect) The border guards will move to your position as soon as they can. They'll take the girl and pass her on to the investigation team, who need someone to guide them across the icefield.
(Ursine dialect) Your role ends there.

steps.name: Ivan
steps.text: (Ursine dialect) Understood. I'll go ahead and prepare the signal beacon to connect at any time.

steps.name: Ivan
steps.text: (Ursine dialect) My apologies, little one.

steps.name: Ursus Officer
steps.text: My apologies, 'friend.'

steps.name: Sami Warrior
steps.text: What are you doing?! Lower your weapons!

steps.name: Ursus Officer
steps.text: My duty is to expand our territory for His Majesty the Emperor.

steps.name: Sami Warrior
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Ursus Officer
steps.text: From today onwards, this too is Ursus territory.

steps.name: Sami Warrior
steps.text: No, what? What exactly do you mean?!

steps.name: Ursus Officer
steps.text: Did I not make myself clear, barbarian?

steps.name: Ursus Officer
steps.text: This is the only settlement within a hundred kilometers. Once we occupy it, great Ursus will naturally be the master of this land.

steps.name: Ursus Officer
steps.text: As this is now Ursus territory, I must request that you leave.

steps.name: Sami Warrior
steps.text: We've been living here for ages, while all you've done is plant a flag! What grounds do you have to claim this land as yours?!

steps.name: Ursus Officer
steps.text: Because we're here now. No more reason is needed.

steps.name: Ursus Officer
steps.text: Hmm... In honor of our friendship and mutual assistance against the demons, I'll give each of you two choices. Leave this place at once, or become subjects of Ursus.

steps.name: Ursus Officer
steps.text: You and your people are excellent warriors, so our nation will gladly welcome you.

steps.name: Ursus Officer
steps.text: Of course, you must learn to speak Ursine, wear Ursus clothing, and most importantly, abandon your abominable and heretical beliefs.

steps.name: Sami Warrior
steps.text: You!

steps.name: Sami Shaman
steps.text: (Silently mouths a spell)

steps.name: Ursus Officer
steps.text: Caster, shut that witch up.

steps.name: Sami Shaman
steps.text: Urgh...

steps.name: Sami Warrior
steps.text: Freya!

steps.name: Ursus Officer
steps.text: Don't do anything foolish, and don't even think about resisting.

steps.name: Sami Warrior
steps.text: (Speaking in Sami) O old tree, I plead you bear witness in my stead...

steps.name: Sami Warrior
steps.text: HEAAAAARGH!!!!!

steps.name: Ursus Officer
steps.text: You leave me no choice, 'friend.'

steps.name: Ursus Officer
steps.text: All units, attack.

steps.name: Ivan
steps.text: (Ursine dialect) Please speak.

(Ursine dialect) The wind from the direction of the border guards seems off, so there might be an incoming snowstorm. Find an open space to deploy a signal beacon for them, and upon making contact, take the target and leave the area immediately.

steps.name: Ivan
steps.text: (Ursine dialect) Understood.

steps.name: Ivan
steps.text: I see you're done collecting samples.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: This tree has some amazing properties. Biologically speaking, it's completely withered. But what's strange is how parts of it still feel alive and well.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: With more thorough research, I might even be able to publish a whole paper on it.

steps.name: Ivan
steps.text: A great blessing to academia, no doubt.

steps.name: Ivan
steps.text: But there's a snowstorm coming, so you'd better go shelter in the outpost first.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Ah, gotcha.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: You're not joining me, Mr. Ivan?

steps.name: Ivan
steps.text: I'm going to go check the scale of the storm, so that if the weather worsens we'll still have a chance to send for help.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Oh, okay.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Please, have some of this before you go.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: I just heated up some water, so have a cup to warm yourself up.

steps.name: Ivan
steps.text: That's alright, I'll be right back.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Mr. Ivan...

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Wait, why am I hiding in here by the fire while he's hard at work outside? That doesn't seem right...

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: I'm an explorer, aren't I? How can I let my companion face this alone?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Maybe I should—

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: So cold...

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: (Looks towards window)

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Oww, my face hurts...

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: The wind's picking up.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: You need to be careful, Mr. Ivan.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: That's...

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Mr. Ivan?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: No, that's not, that's—?!
A gust of wind kicks up waves of snow, pouring towards the outpost.
However, the waves seem to advance only sluggishly, at a controlled speed. As if commanded to do so.
This is not an optical illusion caused by the distance, but the wind and snow are indeed following orders.
They dare not let even a snowflake overtake their leader without permission.
And she, currently leading the wind's charge, holds her scepter high as she slowly makes her way towards the outpost.
One step, then another.
Smooth, steady, unquestionable.
Until the land is buried beneath the wind and snow.
Or so it might have gone. But Magallan welcomes this scene, more than anyone else on the northern frontier.
Because the woman walking amongst the ice and snow is her best friend on the icefield.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Simone!
As her shout travels across the snow, Magallan clearly feels the wind subside.
The waves of snow behind Simone vanish without a trace as she walks up to Magallan.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Hello, Magallan.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Shouldn't you be out on an icefield expedition? What brings you here?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: A professor I respect has gone missing out there, but Ursus blocked the route, again. So I have to take the long way around.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: I warmed up some tea, want some?

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Why, thank you.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: *glug*...*glug*...

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Phew—

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: So, you want to enter the icefield from Sami.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Uh-huh.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Ah, right. Simone, you're a Sami, right?

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: That I am.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Then you—

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: How could I possibly not help out a good acquaintance?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Ehehe~

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Okay, then I'll say goodbye to Mr. Ivan when he gets back, and then we can head into Sami.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Although I've heard it's kinda primitive there, and really scary.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Is that... what the Ursus Messenger told you?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: He also said there's a witch around here who attacks people for no reason, so I should be careful.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: The Ursus are all like that.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: So what kind of person do you imagine this witch to be?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Hmm... a little scary, just like this tree.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: *sigh* Mr. Ivan really seems to loathe Sami, though.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: He was so upfront about it, too.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Us Sami hate the Ursus just as much.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: But why? Couldn't you just talk out this misunderstanding?

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Because to them, conquest is far simpler than understanding. They may see just one annoying witch, but countless Sami have already—

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: —No, it's getting late. Where did you say your friend was headed?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: North, towards the snowstorm.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Wait here, I'll go help him out.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: I think it's better if we go together—

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Stay put, Magallan.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: You're safer in here.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: O-Okay then...

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Be careful out there, Simone.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Mhm.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Um, and be careful of the witch, yeah?

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Hah. If she does show up, I'll be sure to stay far away from her.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: In the meantime, could you warm up some more tea?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Mmhmm!

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: And now I'm all alone, again.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: I hope Mr. Ivan and Simone can get along out there...

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: *sigh*...

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: What do you think, Mr. Tree?
The ancient, dead tree responds with silence.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: I still don't get it. How can they fight off a common enemy together one minute, and go for each other's throats the next?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Isn't cooperation obviously the better choice?
The venerable tree ponders for a moment, and decides to answer by smacking its withered branches together.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: What about you, Mr. Tree? Did you come here to this snowfield all on your own because other people couldn't understand you?
The towering tree feels the question is difficult to answer, so chooses to remain silent.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: You're right... that was a stupid question.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: But if possible, I still hope we can—
I'm back.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Simone?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Oh, here's your tea.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: So where's Mr. Ivan?

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: I looked where you told me to, but couldn't find the Messenger you mentioned.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: The storm from the north is close.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Perhaps he's already rendezvoused with the border guards he called for help, and taken refuge with them.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Ursus sentry outposts aren't sturdy enough to withstand a snowstorm this strong. This building will be completely crushed.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: We might also want to...

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Can we... wait just a bit longer? Mr. Ivan is a pretty experienced Messenger, and we've known each other a long time, so I don't think he'd be caught by a snowstorm like this.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: If you insist. Just a bit longer.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: I'll let the old tree know that we're safe.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: The old tree... Simone, are you from around here?

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: It used to be my duty to protect this unchanging old tree.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: It may have transcended death, but failed to be remembered.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: And to think all this happened because of a moment of kind-heartedness.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: We sow goodwill only to reap evil. This is how the land does things.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: So, that's why there's a... witch roaming nearby.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Perhaps.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: It's about time. We'll be trapped in here if we don't get moving.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: What are you doing?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Finding a spot protected from the wind, to leave a mark for him.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: I have to at least let him know I made it out safely.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Hmm... that should do it.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: I'm leaving, Mr. Ivan.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Goodbye.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Let's go, Magallan.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Mhm.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: The wind and snow seem so docile when I'm with you, Simone.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Just a little Arts I happen to know.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Hmm... That communicator on your shoulder... I feel like I've seen it somewhere before.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: This? I bought it from the Ursus. It works quite well.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Do you need one?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: I'm good. Columbian communicators are way easier to use than Ursus ones.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Ah... Simone?

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Yes?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: There's something... I need to apologize to you for. I hope you won't get angry.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: I won't know until I hear it.

steps.name: 'Magallan'
steps.text: Erm, so earlier, at the sentry outpost, I got a little excited and took some samples from Mr. Tree.

steps.name: 'Santalla'
steps.text: Did you harm the old tree?

steps.name: 'Magallan'
steps.text: N-No, the thing is, I did intend to make a hole to collect a sample, but as soon as I touched it, it just dropped two pieces of bark.

steps.name: 'Magallan'
steps.text: So really, I didn't—

steps.name: 'Santalla'
steps.text: Bark?

steps.name: 'Magallan'
steps.text: Yeah, please don't get mad. I didn't doodle on it or anything.

steps.name: 'Santalla'
steps.text: May I... see them?

steps.name: 'Magallan'
steps.text: Eh? O-Okay.

steps.name: 'Santalla'
steps.text: (Tries putting the pieces of bark together)

steps.name: 'Santalla'
steps.text: (Gydia...)

steps.name: 'Santalla'
steps.text: (Heillir...?)

steps.name: 'Santalla'
steps.text: (Thank you. Thank you so much.)

steps.name: 'Magallan'
steps.text: What is it, Simone?

steps.name: 'Santalla'
steps.text: Oh, nothing...

steps.name: 'Santalla'
steps.text: Keep these with you. The old tree won't blame you for it.

steps.name: 'Magallan'
steps.text: Oh.

steps.name: 'Magallan'
steps.text: Thank you, Mr. Tree.

steps.name: 'Santalla'
steps.text: Yes, praise be the old tree.

steps.name: 'Santalla'
steps.text: The snowstorm will be here soon, so we need to hurry and find somewhere suitable to spend the night.

steps.name: 'Santalla'
steps.text: Let's go.
